operation: shared/joint nearest neighbour vs independent per-view nearest neighbour（多视图异常检测）
citation: Xu, Zhang, Ma, Zhu, Ting. SCoNE: Spherical Consistent Neighborhoods Ensemble for Effective and Efficient Multi-View Anomaly Detection. AAAI 2026 (arXiv:2512.05540)
what_it_establishes: 明确指出既有做法的范式是 using a representation of local neighborhood in each view independently, and then capturing the consistent neighbors across all views via a learning process，并批评 the common practice of linearly combining representations from different views disregards the complex distributions of anomalies；进而提出直接以多视图实例表示跨视图一致邻域（免学习、O(N)）。即：各视图独立最近邻 + 跨视图一致性学习，是该子领域的标准操作与已知缺陷
read_or_listed: read（检索返回的论文正文片段：摘要+引言；arXiv abs 页亦已核对标题与作者）

operation: score-level / late fusion：把不同表征的分数按规则合并
citation: Kittler, Hatef, Duin, Matas. On Combining Classifiers. IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 20(3):226-239, 1998
what_it_establishes: 建立使用 distinct pattern representations 的分类器组合框架，说明多种既有方案是 compound classification（把各表征联合决策）的特例，并用实验与敏感性分析表明 sum rule 在估计误差下最优；是分数层融合（sum/product/max 等规则）的经典理论依据（DOI 未核实，故未记录 DOI）
read_or_listed: listed only（仅读到检索摘要与引用条目，未读原文）

operation: early fusion vs late fusion（融合阶段分类学）
citation: Baltrušaitis, Ahuja, Morency. Multimodal Machine Learning: A Survey and Taxonomy. arXiv:1705.09406 (2017)
what_it_establishes: 提供统一分类，明确 go beyond the typical early and late fusion categorization，并将融合（fusion）列为多模态学习的核心挑战之一；为 early / late / model-level 融合术语与对比框架的标准引用
read_or_listed: read abstract only（已读 arXiv 摘要页全文，未读正文）

operation: learned routing / learned weights 合并多个分支输出（MoE 路由）
citation: Shazeer, Mirhoseini, Maziarz, Davis, Le, Hinton, Dean. Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer. arXiv:1701.06538 (ICLR 2017)；源头为 Jacobs, Jordan, Nowlan, Hinton. Adaptive Mixtures of Local Experts. Neural Computation 3(1), 1991
what_it_establishes: A trainable gating network determines a sparse combination of these experts to use for each example：即分支权重由学习/路由决定并随样本变化，是标准且成熟的做法（与固定加权融合相对）；1991 年原始工作提出 gating network 输出概率分布并对专家输出做 gating 加权组合
read_or_listed: read abstract only（abs 页）；Jacobs 1991 原文未读 = listed only（仅通过二手资料核实卷期页码）

operation: early/middle/late 融合架构的影响 + 新增分支收益的条件性
citation: Long, Xie, Ma, Liu, Lu. Revisiting Multimodal Fusion for 3D Anomaly Detection from an Architectural Perspective. arXiv:2412.17297
what_it_establishes: 实验与理论表明融合拓扑（early/middle/late 模块组合与融合算子选择）显著改变 3D-AD 性能；并由 Dempster-Shafer 证据理论给出 Proposition 1/2：融合新增 opinion 只在特定条件下保证提升，否则可能下降但下降有界——即新增表征分支的收益依赖融合架构
read_or_listed: read（已下载 PDF 并读全文）

operation: 独立参考库 + 分数相加（late fusion）vs 单融合库（feature/early fusion）
citation: Wang, Peng, Zhang, Yi, Wang, Wang. Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection via Hybrid Fusion (M3DM). CVPR 2023 (arXiv:2303.00601)
what_it_establishes: 在同一消融表中给出 1) 仅点云 2) 仅 RGB 3) 单 bank 直接拼接特征 4) 单 bank（融合特征）5) 两 bank 分数相加 6) 两 bank+DLF 7) 三 bank 的完整对照；是记忆库式异常检测中多分支参考库与分数级融合的标准先例
read_or_listed: read（已下载 PDF 并读全文）

operation: 共享参考结构 + 各分支独立参考库（跨模态结构共享）
citation: Lin, Yan, Tong, Chang, Wang, Zhou, Gao, Wang, Zhang. Commonality in Few: Few-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection via Hypergraph-Enhanced Memory (CIF). AAAI 2026 (arXiv:2511.05966)
what_it_establishes: 用 RGB 特征构建的同一超图结构同时引导 2D 与 3D 两个独立 memory bank 的结构化最近邻检索（we uniformly use hypergraphs constructed from RGB image features to support the subsequent modules in both the 2D and 3D modals），说明共享参考结构 + 分支独立最近邻的组合已被实际采用，且其收益在 1/2/4-shot 下被报告
read_or_listed: read（已下载 PDF 并读全文）
